# Immich Importer LXC - Photo Import & Cloud Backup
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 303 (existing)
# IP: 192.168.1.159

# Run immich-go for Google Photos import, rclone for B2 cloud backup.
# Non-Docker LXC with direct tool installation.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 303
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 64
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 512
}

# Backblaze B2 credentials (from 1Password)
variable "b2_account_id" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "b2_application_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "rclone_crypt_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "rclone_crypt_password2" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Immich configuration
variable "immich_server" {
  type    = string
  default = "http://192.168.1.222:2283"
}

variable "immich_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Cloud backup schedule
variable "cloud_backup_schedule" {
  type    = string
  default = "0 3 * * 0,3"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Immich Importer Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-base"

  name         = "immich-importer"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network
  ip_address = "${local.ip_registry.apps.immich_importer}/24"
  gateway    = "192.168.1.1"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Ubuntu template (matches existing container)
  template = "local:vztmpl/ubuntu-24.04-standard_24.04-2_amd64.tar.zst"
  os_type  = "ubuntu"

  # Container features
  unprivileged   = true
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key = local.ssh_public_key

  # Mount points for photos and imports
  mount_points = [
    {
      slot   = 0
      volume = "/tank/photos"
      path   = "/photos"
    },
    {
      slot   = 1
      volume = "/tank/cache/immich"
      path   = "/cache"
    },
    {
      slot   = 2
      volume = "/tank/importer"
      path   = "/importer"
    },
    {
      slot   = 3
      volume = "/tank/photo-import"
      path   = "/downloads"
    }
  ]

  # Proxmox Notes
  description = <<-EOT
# Immich Importer

Photo import (immich-go) and cloud backup (rclone to B2)

## Services

- **immich-go**: Google Photos importer
- **rclone**: Cloud backup to B2 (encrypted)

## Management

- SSH: `ssh root@${local.ip_registry.apps.immich_importer}`

## Cloud Backup

**Schedule:** ${var.cloud_backup_schedule} (Wed and Sun 3 AM EST)

**Commands:**
```bash
task cloud:sync:photos
task cloud:status:photos
task cloud:logs:photos
```

## Manual Import

**Run immich-go:**
```bash
immich-go -server ${var.immich_server} upload /downloads
```

## Rclone Status

**Check B2 sync status:**
```bash
/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh status
```

**Manual sync:**
```bash
/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=immich-importer` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["immich-importer", "backup", "rclone", "opentofu"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Wait for container to be ready
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "time_sleep" "wait_for_container" {
  depends_on      = [module.lxc]
  create_duration = "10s"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Install Dependencies (rclone, immich-go)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "install_dependencies" {
  depends_on = [time_sleep.wait_for_container]

  triggers = {
    container_id = var.container_id
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive",
      "apt-get update -qq",
      "apt-get install -y -qq curl unzip cron",

      # Install rclone
      "if ! command -v rclone &>/dev/null; then curl -fsSL https://rclone.org/install.sh | bash; fi",

      # Install immich-go (latest release)
      "if ! command -v immich-go &>/dev/null; then",
      "  IMMICH_GO_VERSION=$(curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/simulot/immich-go/releases/latest | grep tag_name | cut -d'\"' -f4)",
      "  curl -fsSL https://github.com/simulot/immich-go/releases/download/$${IMMICH_GO_VERSION}/immich-go_Linux_x86_64.tar.gz | tar -xzf - -C /usr/local/bin immich-go",
      "  chmod +x /usr/local/bin/immich-go",
      "fi",

      # Create directories
      "mkdir -p /root/.config/rclone",
      "mkdir -p /var/log",
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configure rclone
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "configure_rclone" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.install_dependencies]

  triggers = {
    container_id    = var.container_id
    b2_account_id   = var.b2_account_id
    crypt_password  = var.rclone_crypt_password
    crypt_password2 = var.rclone_crypt_password2
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      <<-RCLONE
      cat > /root/.config/rclone/rclone.conf << 'CONF'
[b2]
type = b2
account = ${var.b2_account_id}
key = ${var.b2_application_key}
hard_delete = true

[b2-crypt]
type = crypt
remote = b2:rambtech-homelab/photos-encrypted
password = ${var.rclone_crypt_password}
password2 = ${var.rclone_crypt_password2}
CONF
      chmod 600 /root/.config/rclone/rclone.conf
      RCLONE
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deploy Cloud Sync Script
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "deploy_cloud_sync" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.configure_rclone]

  triggers = {
    container_id = var.container_id
    script_hash  = filesha256("${path.module}/deploy/cloud-sync.sh")
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
  }

  provisioner "file" {
    source      = "${path.module}/deploy/cloud-sync.sh"
    destination = "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "chmod +x /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh"
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configure Cron Job for Cloud Backup
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "configure_cron" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.deploy_cloud_sync]

  triggers = {
    container_id = var.container_id
    schedule     = var.cloud_backup_schedule
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      # Remove existing cloud-sync cron entries
      "crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'cloud-sync.sh' | crontab - || true",

      # Add new cron entry
      "(crontab -l 2>/dev/null; echo '${var.cloud_backup_schedule} /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos >> /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1') | crontab -",

      # Ensure cron service is running
      "systemctl enable cron",
      "systemctl start cron",

      "echo 'Cron configured: ${var.cloud_backup_schedule}'"
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.lxc.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.lxc.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.lxc.ssh_command
}

output "cloud_backup_schedule" {
  value = var.cloud_backup_schedule
}

  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  unprivileged = false

  # Mount data directory (for hardlinks to work)
  mount_points = [
    {
      slot   = 0
      path   = "/data"
      volume = "/tank/data"
    }
  ]

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Media Management"
  service_description = "Download clients and library managers with VPN protection"

  service_urls = {

    sonarr      = "https://sonarr.${var.domain_internal}"
    radarr      = "https://radarr.${var.domain_internal}"
    lidarr      = "https://lidarr.${var.domain_internal}"
    prowlarr    = "https://prowlarr.${var.domain_internal}"
    bazarr      = "https://bazarr.${var.domain_internal}"
    sabnzbd     = "https://sabnzbd.${var.domain_internal}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Gluetun", port = 0, info = "VPN gateway (NordVPN WireGuard)" },
    { name = "qBittorrent", port = 8080, info = "BitTorrent client (via VPN)" },
    { name = "SABnzbd", port = 8085, info = "Usenet download client" },
    { name = "Prowlarr", port = 9696, info = "Indexer manager (via VPN)" },
    { name = "FlareSolverr", port = 8191, info = "Cloudflare bypass (via VPN)" },
    { name = "Sonarr", port = 8989, info = "TV show management" },
    { name = "Radarr", port = 7878, info = "Movie management" },
    { name = "Lidarr", port = 8686, info = "Music management" },
    { name = "Bazarr", port = 6767, info = "Subtitle management" },
    { name = "Recyclarr", port = 0, info = "TRaSH Guides sync (scheduled)" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Storage (TRaSH Guides Compliant)

**Data Directory:** `/data` (mounted from `/tank/data`)
- `/data/torrents/movies` - Movie downloads
- `/data/torrents/tv` - TV show downloads
- `/data/torrents/music` - Music downloads
- `/data/library/movies` - Movie library (hardlinks from downloads)
- `/data/library/tv` - TV show library (hardlinks from downloads)
- `/data/library/music` - Music library (hardlinks from downloads)

## VPN Protection

All torrent traffic routes through Gluetun (NordVPN WireGuard):
- qBittorrent, Prowlarr, FlareSolverr use VPN network
- Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Bazarr use host network

**Check VPN status:**
```bash
docker exec gluetun wget -qO- ifconfig.me
```

## Quick Commands

**View all logs:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose logs -f
```

**Restart VPN:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose restart gluetun
```

**Check qBittorrent connectivity:**
```bash
docker exec qbittorrent curl -s ifconfig.me
```

## TRaSH Guides Sync

Recyclarr runs on schedule to sync quality profiles:
```bash
docker exec recyclarr recyclarr sync
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=media-management` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["media", "downloads", "arr"]
}

  gateway    = "192.168.1.1"

  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 1024

  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Privileged for Docker
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host
